A Humble Request to My Teammates

Hey everyone, just a small request to help us manage the work and everyone’s time a little better.

Whenever you’re wrapping up for the day or going offline, please share a quick update on whatever you worked on that day — even if it’s something small.

Also, if you’re stuck on something or a task is taking longer than expected, please mention that too. That’s also a useful update. It helps me understand where support is needed, and I can either jump in, help unblock it, or bring someone else in so we can move things forward without putting too much pressure on one person.

The main idea is just to have better visibility on who is working on what, what’s progressing, and where we might need extra help.

You can share the update with me personally or in the group, whichever is easier. This will make it much easier for all of us to plan the work better and avoid last-minute confusion.

Thanks!
